home._eventsCount_context: Pluralised event counter shown next to the Filters button. Romance languages: feminine plural agreement.

tournamentTabs._context: Premier Padel and FIP are organisations — proper nouns. Do NOT translate.

fipTier._all_context: Filter chip meaning "all FIP tiers". Feminine plural in Spanish (Todas) because it agrees with implied "tournaments".
fipTier._tier_context: Platinum/Gold/Silver/Bronze/Beyond/Promises are FIP tournament tier proper nouns. Do NOT translate.

tournamentList._completedYear_context: Section header for past tournaments grouped by calendar year. "Completed" is an adjective agreeing with "tournaments" — feminine plural in Romance languages.
tournamentList._viewEvent_context: Short CTA on a tournament card. Verb meaning "look at" / "see". ES: "Ver".
tournamentList._daysLabel_context: Standalone uppercase label below a numeric countdown (e.g. "14 / DAYS"). Translation may keep all-caps if natural; otherwise short word.
tournamentList._removeFilter_context: aria-label on the X button of an active-filter chip. {label} is the filter name (e.g. "2025", country code).

filterSheet.title: Filters
filterSheet._currentBadge_context: Tiny inline badge appended to the current-year button — short "now"/"this one" indicator.

whenChip._context: Compact labels used inside an active-filter chip (the chip is small, so the words drop "Next").

filterSheet._status_context: Adjectives describing tournament state. Feminine plural in Romance languages because they agree with "tournaments".
filterSheet.applyWithCount: Apply ({count, plural, one {# event} other {# events}})

bracket.noDrawForCategory: No draw data available for this category.

tournament.noPbpCoverage: Live point-by-point scoring is not available for this event.
tournament._noPbpCoverage_context: Disclaimer shown on the tournament detail page when the event level does not include per-point data from padelapi.org (lower-tier events). Sentence case, ends with period. "Point-by-point" = the granular per-shot scoring data; not "match-by-match".
tournament._predicted_context: Tiny badge indicating that a result was inferred (not from a live feed). Short uppercase word fits the badge.
tournament.checkBackAfterTournament: Check back after the tournament ends
tournament._liveCountChip_context: Small live-match counter chip on the tournament header (e.g. "3 LIVE"). Pluralisation is implicit; if a target locale needs different plural forms, use ICU here.

about.title: About Padel Nachos
about.tagline: Live padel scores with a side of fun
about.storyP1: Padel Nachos was born from a simple frustration. It was too hard to follow live padel matches. Scores were scattered across apps, social media, and official sites with no single place to get everything.
about.storyP2: We built PadelNachos to be that place. A fast, beautiful, free platform where fans can follow every point, every tournament, every player, from Premier Padel majors to FIP Gold events.
about.offerRankings: Official FIP rankings for men and women
about.offerDraws: Tournament draws and order of play
about.offerHighlights: Video highlights from top padel channels
about.dataP1: Our scores come from official tournament APIs and are verified against multiple sources. During live matches, data refreshes constantly to keep you as close to real-time as possible.
about.dataP2: We already track more than 3,000 players across men's and women's categories, and our database keeps growing every week.
